title: Keys Inc. builds AI-powered parts marketplace
description:
Keys Inc. is expanding its software ecosystem to include a full procurement network, it announced Aug. 7. The system will allow locksmiths to identify, source, compare and order automotive keys directly through its app without contacting distributors by phone. Keys is an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered platform serving the U.S. locksmith and roadside service industry. The […]

title: The simple way to make your marketing claims 42.9% more believable
description: A few weeks back, I stumbled across a Reddit post that talked about the first measurement ever taken of Mount Everest. Rather than listing the exact measurement of 29,000 feet, the British Royal Geographical Society declared Mount Everest’s elevation to be 29,002 feet. It’s one of those facts that seems fake, but there’s good evidence that it’s true.
